evaluations.assessment: Host role and valid tenant security scope checked before scoped target resolution; deleted/nonstaff/cross-tenant targets do not produce metadata. Existing policy evaluates the complete role set, not just one staff role. Suspended reads remain allowed; requested work role is enforced separately. Composition uses Identity/Session/Scoring public facades and scalar DTOs, not cross-module repositories. Canonical Attempt context excludes unresolved/deleted/cross-session references before progress.

evaluations.area: Cache generation, target remount and canonical mutation response
evaluations.assessment: Workspace keys contain authenticated tenant, selected staff and request predicates/status/page. Route keys target view; inactive role tabs disable workload queries and AbortSignal reaches transport. Existing provider cancels/clears queries on actor/tenant session changes and client rejects stale-generation responses. Profile PATCH captures exact tenant/target key and generation, cancels prior/inflight detail reads, checks generation again after await, and installs canonical response before invalidating staff prefix. No temporary credential response is installed as query data.

New staff PATCH permits only fullName/email/phone/dateOfBirth; preserves username/roles/status/student fields. Server validates required staff name/email, mapped lengths and DOB, trims nullable phone, canonicalizes email. Existing send-email workflow remains authoritative and rejects any STUDENT role; staff capability disables unsupported mixed-role credential email. Learner retains its separate generateStudentCredentials flow. Lifecycle actions remain existing identity commands, not workload writes.

evaluations.area: Database email integrity and additive migrations
evaluations.assessment: App canonical-email precheck is backed by a tenant/nondeleted/nonblank lower(trim(email)) unique index, including concurrent conflicts. V92 explicitly fails on existing collisions without exposing values or deleting/merging users. Expected unique-index violation maps to friendly conflict; other integrity failures are not swallowed. V93 supports schedule and inverse Proctor predicates. No database/migration execution or index/query-plan performance proof is inferred.

evaluations.area: Canonical eligibility, submitted-answer integrity and bounded scans
evaluations.assessment: Assignment and answer scans use bounded size100 closed scalar slices; Session uses scalar Criteria tuple/count reads, not managed history retention. Canonical pinned task counts use the existing scoring resolver and compare against actual eligible answer count and frozen denominator, including zero. Submitted score requires valid owner/scope/eligible membership/SUBMITTED/time/range; unmatched or inconsistent rows become UNAVAILABLE. Unique immutable assignment/answer-score identities support distinctness. Batch-id ordered scan counts supplemental batches with one session accumulator, not one card per batch. Only requested page records and bounded batch accumulators are retained; full-filter scans still have dataset-proportional cost and are not benchmarked.

evaluations.area: Nullability, units, totals and exception reconciliation
evaluations.assessment: Backend/client distinguish session/attempt/batch/eligible/submitted units. Unavailable session whole eligible/submitted/percent are explicit null; assignment/frozen metadata and verified attempt subtotals remain independent. Overview coverage flag and separately named partial verified counts prevent partial totals masquerading as whole-workload progress. Zero-work displays no eligible answers, empty overview no assignments; no out-of-range progress bar. Status totals accumulate after shared base filters before workStatus/page selection, including UNAVAILABLE, and reconcile totalSessions.

Each visible normal status and technical UNAVAILABLE bucket has independent bounded server page5/count/error branch; table page20 ALL includes exceptions. Apply/Clear revision resets pages even for identical predicates. Visible work selector changes request-backed columns/table predicates, never client official totals. Publication independent of completion and published history retained. Staff workload UI only navigates to Host session details; no personal examiner route, score editing, grading/batch/assignment command, DnD or impersonation. New GET call graph contains only reads/cache resolution, no preview expiry/report creation/status advancement.

evaluations.area: Timezone/filter identity and honest Proctor preview
evaluations.assessment: Session selector uses actual sessionPublicId, no invented exam/template identity. Same scoped date/status base predicates drive overview/list/count; UI converts calendar bounds in explicit UTC+7 with next calendar day exclusive end. Missing/invalid schedule is excluded with date bounds; displayed times share Asia/Ho_Chi_Minh. Preview recomputes current Instant each query execution, bounded3 stable key, includes overdue openings only while not ended. Remaining-assignment lifecycle buckets reconcile without attendance claims. Tenant session catalog is existing option-only source, not workload count/all-pages filtering.

evaluations.area: Common presentation, Learner migration and current shared consumers
evaluations.assessment: Common Profile/Board primitives own presentation slots only; no feature DTO/query/mutation imports. Learner diff preserves original account editor/data flow, student-code copy, overview default, history active gating and existing credential/lifecycle commands; actions/dialog extraction is feature-local. Staff uses stock common controls, role badges from full array, thin awaited-param route and installed Next error retry API. No global visual default override or broader Student reporting/assignProctor change. Rendered mobile/keyboard/theme behavior remains manual, not proven by source.

US01-09 manual checklist and runtime security/database follow-up owners are explicit. Fresh user-supplied static checks recorded separately from independent review. Backend latest compile is classes-up-to-date BUILD SUCCESS, not a new full-source/runtime execution claim. Login HTTP200 is listener/login availability only. Previous phase receipts are correctly described as historical snapshots; this current union supersedes their source fingerprints for integration coverage. No unrun tests, migration, PostgreSQL or authenticated-browser success is claimed.
